findings.title: Check the conditions behind supported/refused protocol alternatives
findings.reason: The new typed templates still permit removal of required output rows by selecting an impossible refusal/unavailable branch. An update-weather refusal carrying in_cockpit=0,camera=1,comms_model equal to census comms_server is accepted even though the unchanged C refusal predicate is false; its full before/after state rows disappear. The initializer refusal similarly permits the server value. A retail snapshot with an in-domain gusting_value_w can accept wind=unavailable_gust_outside_0_1 instead of the four wind values. The new positive stand-in itself sets gusting_value_w=3f800000 (outside domain) while returning supported wind queries. Its wind row also says null_same=1 with unequal speed_w/null_speed_w; that flag is defined by direct word equality in the emitter. These are local context/diagnostic inconsistencies, not requests to assert a weather/wind solver result.
findings.correction: Validate supported/refused guards using reported census/server and snapshot/witness context: refusal must satisfy at least one actual guard, supported context must satisfy its complement, and query wind availability must match the enclosing snapshot gust domain. Make positive collaborators coherent. Validate the null_same flag against its own two printed words with legitimate equal/unequal controls. Add actual real-script negatives for impossible refusal and false wind unavailability; retain existing cases and do not rederive physical speeds/weather answers.
findings.evidence_basis: Concrete new source/template paths and new collaborator literals; no new malformed-control execution by reviewer is claimed. Actual retained original/native compatibility reports show none of these defects.
